generatedCommentsNodes.comment: In the `createDynamicMapperBuilderContext` method, the `MergeReason.MAPPING_UPDATE` is hardcoded. This might not be appropriate for all dynamic mappings and could lead to incorrect behavior if a different merge reason is required in some contexts.

The `parseMapping` method now requires a `MergeReason` parameter, but in some cases, the existing code does not provide this parameter. This will cause compilation errors or runtime issues if the method signature is strictly enforced.
The import statement for `MapperService.MergeReason` is added here. Ensure that this import is necessary and used consistently across all relevant files where `MergeReason` is referenced.

review_comment: To be safe, could you also add a test for the invers? Have the nested notation first (mapping2) and then the dot notation (mapping1). In theory, should not make a difference but I rather have one test to much then too little.
Sure! I added that scenario with [cb28cdb](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/106077/commits/cb28cdbe5a47b0d3b527087acc192abfa387d266).
